events.description: The Hand becomes the leaders of El-Beth-El and attended the dinner party in their honor.
The Hand suppressed a cult of Deos called -The Surviving- gaining the trust and loyalty of Rime Mugwes. The reaction of the population has yet to be seen.
The Hand dealt with the four kingdoms of El-Beth-El but yet have to gain their respect. Nonetheless the kingdoms respected their authority (at least so it appeared).
The hand was declared war on. They went to Ashran to ensure their loyalty and kick Arakne out of the system.
The Hand takes the troops of Bataar and starts to unify its army

events.modifier: Army is ready. Spelljaming level increases by one. Civil war roll. Hai arrive.
